data.name: Changes
data.value: Setup installs the classroom agent, names this PC, configures firewall discovery, power and Wake-on-LAN, and adds a Defender exclusion. With student creation enabled, privacy, browser first-run and OneDrive sign-in notifications are suppressed by machine policy, including for other users. Administrator elevation asks for a username and password before the administrator tile is hidden; this machine policy affects all users. Local password length/complexity policy may be relaxed if required to create the student. Previous settings are recorded for removal. Personal accounts and files are preserved.

data.name: WakeWindowsConfigured

data.name: PushConfigured
data.value: [Network updates] Agent service, discovery firewall rules and service recovery are configured. Keep the teacher console running on this LAN; unlock its lab key and send an agent update from the console. Acceptance requires ten continuous minutes of connection, with automatic recovery if the new agent fails.

data.name: UninstallFailed
data.value: Removal did not finish. Review the console message and retry from Installed apps after resolving the problem. Ownership history was retained; any previously confirmed student removal will resume on retry.

data.name: OperationFailed
data.value: Setup could not complete this operation. Review the console message before retrying. Unresolved ownership history was preserved.

data.name: SignInSidBaselineUnknown
data.value: [Warning] This installation did not record the original Windows automatic sign-in SID. AutoLogonSID is preserved; its original value cannot be restored automatically. Other recorded sign-in settings retain their protected restoration history.
